# Fine Tuning

Fine-tuning adjusts pre-trained model weights for a specific dataset.

## Relationship
- Fine-tuning is a specific technique within [[Transfer Learning]].
- Both [[PyTorch]] and [[TensorFlow]] support fine-tuning.
